opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: Applicants can apply for up to £200,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the duration of the award, based in a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation. Lead applicants may include up to two Co-applicants covering different Academy remits.
opportunities.summary: Cross-academy interdisciplinary research awards (Academies Partnership in Supporting Excellence in Cross-disciplinary research) supporting genuine interdisciplinary and curiosity-driven research across science, engineering, social sciences and humanities, held for up to 24 months.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call, across all career stages. Previous successful recipients of this award are not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a GLAM organisation or performing arts organisation.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: The symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs. Seed funding will be made available for which participants can apply.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany.
opportunities.summary: Research collaboration symposium for early career researchers in the humanities and social sciences on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', bringing together around 15 UK and 15 German early career researchers.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: The Academy funds 80 per cent of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC. Three year award.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation. British citizens and EEA nationals eligible regardless of doctorate origin; anyone with a UK doctorate eligible. Viva completed between 1 April 2024 and 1 April 2027. No permanent academic post held.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences to pursue an independent research project towards completion of a significant piece of publishable research.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in the humanities and social sciences ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO that will continue for the full duration of the award.
opportunities.summary: Awards to promote acquisition and advancement of skills (e.g. quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities, languages) and innovative research methods by UK-based researchers, held for 6-12 months.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: Up to £300,000 over 2 years, offered at 80% FEC (total project value at 100% FEC may not exceed £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute with an established role lasting at least the award duration, of postdoctoral status or above, spending at least 20% time. Co-Applicants based overseas required.
opportunities.summary: International interdisciplinary research projects led by UK-based researchers in the humanities and social sciences, working with international partners, on the theme of Mobilities. Awards of 24 months duration.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27

amount.raw: Up to £150,000 for 12 months in duration (with Full Economic Costing at 80 per cent)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: One-year fellowships for UK-based early- and mid-career researchers to embed themselves in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin, developing skills, networks and careers in policy sectors.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: Funding of up to £4,000 (in exceptional circumstances above £4,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders OR applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months who need support with submitting their application.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require, such as specific equipment to overcome barriers to disabled people undertaking research, assistance for those with sensory impairment, caring costs for research trips, and support to make an application. Offered on a rolling deadline.

opportunities.title: British Academy/Leverhulme Small Research Grants

amount.raw: Up to £10,000 (applications for less than £500 will not be considered)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral scholars (or equivalent) ordinarily resident in the United Kingdom, and independent scholars. Applications require approval of the employing institution.
opportunities.summary: Small research grants, up to £10,000 and tenable for up to 24 months, to cover the cost of expenses arising from a defined research project in the humanities and social sciences. Scheme opens 2 September 2026.
